class.name: IfcRampType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : The element type IfcRampType defines a list of commonly shared property set definitions of a ramp and an optional set of product representations. It is used to define a ramp specification (i.e. the specific product information, that is common to all occurrences of that product type).
